limitations: Read-only review did not rebuild or deploy the final integrated site. Real generation uses canonical source bundles from the existing recovery site; chronology content/layout acceptance belongs to the other lane.
Actual browsers are desktop Chromium 156.0.8078.79 with mobile viewport emulation, not physical Android/iOS or Safari.

The 4x CPU setting slowed only the main thread; worker calibration remained approximately 1x. pdfTeX timings may overlap chronology work and are not an isolated benchmark. Transfer counts and output fidelity remain directly measured.
Selective pdfTeX sampled peak renderer PSS was 544988 KiB; this is not evidence for low-memory-device compatibility. Samples occurred every 250ms.

Real engines cover one pdfTeX and one XeTeX edition, plus a cancellation/retry. This does not certify all 644 editions. Service protocol/error tests use synthetic responses; no external PDF service was called.

No new tracked tests or code were written by this review lane. Reused CDP/mock transport mechanics are identified in scratch scripts; findings were derived from fresh executions rather than earlier verdicts.
